# Private Academy

> Private Academy (https://www.privateacademy.in) is an engineering study hub and notes library offering syllabus-aligned study materials, semester question guides, project source code, and video tutorials for Mumbai University, SPPU, DBATU, and leading Indian engineering universities.

## Primary Sections
- [Home Page](https://www.privateacademy.in): Comprehensive engineering study hub and resource portal.
- [Academic Articles](https://www.privateacademy.in/articles): Detailed study guides, syllabus explanations, exam preparation tips, and subject breakdowns.
- [Engineering Projects](https://www.privateacademy.in/projects): Micro and mini project source code, documentation, and live demos for IT & Computer engineering.
- [Student Discussions](https://www.privateacademy.in/discussions): Community doubt-solving, peer Q&A, and semester question discussions.
- [Contribute Notes](https://www.privateacademy.in/contribute): Platform for engineering students and educators to share verified study resources.
- [About Us](https://www.privateacademy.in/about): Learn about Private Academy's mission and founding vision by Karan Gholap.

## Covered Engineering Disciplines & Universities
- **Universities:** Mumbai University (MU), Savitribai Phule Pune University (SPPU), Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Technological University (DBATU), and leading technical institutes.
- **Branches:** Computer Engineering, Information Technology (IT), Artificial Intelligence & Data Science (AIDS), Electronics & Telecommunication (EXTC).
- **Resources:** Handwritten & typed study notes, previous year question paper solutions, syllabus blueprints, and semester projects.

## Community & Social Profiles
- [Telegram Community](https://t.me/mumcomputer): 2,500+ active engineering members.
